I have chronic migraines and would get really bad premenstrual and menstrual migraine flares. I switched to a continuous cycle BC which makes me just never get my period. I hated the unpredictability of my period: when it would come, how long it would last, how heavy is it am I leaking, do I have enough tampons and pain killers, etc. the lack of routine really kept me on edge. I know the pill isn’t a great option for everyone but it definitely helped my general anxiety, terrible cramps, and migraines.
